Container.Name: nimbus-postgres
Container.Overview:
PostgreSQL 18 database for the Nimbus dashboard. Install this first, then the "nimbus" template, and use the same database password in both.
The database port is published on your server so the Nimbus container can reach it. Pick a strong password, or put both containers on a custom Docker network and remove the port.

Config.Name: Database port
Config.Description: Host port of the database. Change it when another PostgreSQL container already uses 5432, and set the same port in Nimbus.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Password for the nimbus database user. Letters, digits, - and _ only. Enter the same one in the Nimbus container.

Config.Name: PGDATA
Config.Description: Do not change: the image refuses any other value
